annotations.text:
L1 hero = the ACTIVE PLAN, not a ranked guess.
"Next in your split" and computeNextTemplate's hero ranking are deleted. Tap a routine, start it. History is demoted to flat rows so three layers finally read as three layers.

Library splits into Plans | Exercises.
Routines belong to a plan, which is what a split becomes when you add it. Edit / duplicate / delete live on the routine row. Exercises gains a create button that no longer needs an active workout.
A real editor — not the live workout UI with the Finish button relabelled. Saves in place, keeps the routine id, so week-plan assignments survive.
Composer is a multi-line textarea. Return adds a line. Key and clear move into the header instead of being stranded off the right edge of a scrolling chip row.
One card, paged — replaces the vertical stack of daily pick + weekly review + N findings.
